snippet.title: Starball gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Starball, Dos PC game produced by GameTek in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/starball/8215/
Starball is an interesting and unique pinball game. The main pinball table consists of 3 main levels, each with its own pair of flippers.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
